scope: npm example's socket-status display; no library API change
environment: Codex in-app browser, installed Saylo alpha.4 packages and Vite 8.3.3

before.reproduction: Stop Vite dev server while the confirmation dialog is open

after.statusAfterDisconnect: Disconnected. Waiting for the development server; last rendered translations remain visible.

serverRestart.behavior: Vite reloads the entire page on server recovery

regression.scope: Production bundle: cached/discarded page lifecycles and missing-message repair. Socket behavior above was checked in a live browser.

limits: The socket-reconnect waiting branch was not independently observed; a complete Vite restart reloads the page.
Internal snapshot retry attempts and exhausted-resync status still need distinct library signals and UI handling.
Catalog edits preserve DOM state; server restarts do not promise draft persistence.
No package version bump, publish, or push.
